mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5%, it signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5% (sign test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in labor market strength (PAYEMS) and housing demand (HOUST) signal a broad-based economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and HOUST fails to predict negative returns (Rank IC < 0.03) or the correlation between the joint signal and negative returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strengthening economic output, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO trend fails to predict positive returns (Rank IC < 0.03) or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in rising INDPRO periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 900.0 thousand units, it signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 900.0 (sign test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal an impending recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising FEDFUNDS and UNRATE fails to predict negative returns (Rank IC < 0.03) or the correlation is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during late-cycle expansions when GDPC1 declines (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.
